sources.title: txgsync/kokoro-82m-coreml-ane · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A self-contained, fixed-revision Core ML build of the Kokoro-82M 7-stage Apple-Neural-Engine pipeline packaged with all 54 standard Kokoro voices, so a sandboxed Swift / Core ML app can offer every voice on the ANE path from a single hash-pinnable download.
